correctness.rationale: The proof separates the allowed color vectors by the number of size-(s+1) classes. The one-large-class case follows from an independent odd-cycle transversal together with an exact flow-and-arrangement theorem for prescribed colorings of bipartite maximum-degree-two graphs; the two-large-class case follows from an equitable 3-coloring and splitting its third independent class.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. Birken's arXiv:2609.18629v1 states the strengthened nondivisible-order assertion as Conjecture 5 and does not settle its r=2 case. Exact and synonymous searches did not locate a prior theorem implying the main result. Very recent parallel work or older equivalent constrained-coloring terminology remains a residual risk.

value.rationale: The result resolves the first nontrivial maximum-degree case of an explicit strengthening of the Hajnal--Szemeredi theorem and supplies a sharp necessary-and-sufficient prescribed-coloring criterion for bipartite graphs of maximum degree two.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, or a guarantee of first discovery.
